description: Prepares (does not send) an unsigned Solana transaction that sells a Backed xStock for USDC via Jupiter. amountShares is in shares as wallets display them, or 'max' for the whole balance. Returns the base64 versioned transaction and a sign link. Nothing is executed: the user reviews and signs it in their own wallet.

amountShares.description: Number of xStock SHARES to sell — the unit get_portfolio and wallets display (includes reinvested dividends), e.g. '0.02'. Converted to on-chain token units internally. Or 'max' to sell the entire balance exactly.

ticker.description: Stock ticker to sell, e.g. NVDA

name: build_sell_xstock_tx

error.description: Why the transaction could not be prepared

ok.description: false when the transaction could not be prepared (see error)

signId.description: Id of the prepared, unsigned transaction

signUrl.description: Page where the user reviews and signs in their own wallet (null in local stdio mode)

unsignedTransaction.description: Base64 versioned Solana transaction plus lastValidBlockHeight
